description: This stunning luxury apartment, featuring 4 bedrooms and tastefully renovated with high-quality materials, is located just steps from Place Victor Hugo.Its elegant and refined atmosphere offers a true sanctuary of serenity, perfect for relaxing and recharging.Whether for a business stay or a Parisian getaway, experience luxury and the Parisian art of living during your visit.The spaceThis stunning apartment in the heart of the 16th arrondissement has been fully renovated and equipped, offering optimal comfort for an unforgettable stay in Paris. It features two spacious living rooms, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, a bar, and a room with a cinema screen and projector. The apartment also includes an audio-visual system, a fireplace, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and balconies that fill the rooms with natural light.It has five bedrooms, all with en-suite bathrooms, TVs, and exceptional brightness thanks to the balconies:Bedroom 1: King-size bed, en-suite bathroom, dressing area, TVBedroom 2: Queen-size bed, en-suite bathroom, desk, TVBedroom 3: King-size bed, en-suite bathroom, fireplace, TVBedroom 4: Double bed, en-suite bathroom, desk, TVBedroom 5 (guest/staff studio): Queen-size bed, en-suite bathroom, TV, private entrance, kitchenetteEach bathroom is fully equipped for your comfort. The apartment is ideal for family stays, trips with friends, or business visits, offering luxury, space, tranquility, and a bright atmosphere thanks to the balconies, all set within an elegant Parisian setting.Guest accessThe apartment is located in a prestigious and quiet neighborhood, just minutes from luxury shops, fine dining restaurants, Parisian cafés, and iconic landmarks.Access is easy via public transport, with the Victor Hugo metro station on line 2 just steps away.
